description: 3-phase energy analyzer, Modbus RTU RS-485. All 32-bit IEEE 754 float or 32-bit/64-bit int; each 32-bit value = 2 Modbus words (addr stride +2). FC03 read, FC06/FC10 write. Global at addr 0-26: V-avg, I-total, P/Q/S-total, cosΦ/PF-avg, VLL1/2/3/avg, IN, THDV/THDI-total. Per-phase at 28-150 (L1), 152-274 (L2), 276-398 (L3): V/I/P/Q/S/cosΦ/PF/F/THDV/THDI + voltage harmonics (1st-51st odd, 26 entries) + current harmonics (1st-51st odd, 26 entries). Alarm flags 400-402. Tariff meters T1/T1_1/T1_2/T1_3/T2 import/export active+reactive (32-bit float, kWh/kVArh) at 404-682. Demand peak (current month + 3 prior months) at 684-938. DI counters 940-958. Temp/battery/time 944-948. Alarm statuses (50 alarms) at 960-1358. Archive file numbers 1360-1364. Tariff indices (64-bit double) at 1366-1444. Phase energies (64-bit) at 1458-1694. Digital output logs 1698-1808. DI energy counters 1810-1836. Clear commands 1898-1916. Settings at 2000-2390: CTR/VTR, connection, demand period, energy tariff presets, digital outputs/inputs, baud rate, slave ID, alarm limits (V-LN/LL, I, P, Q, S, IN, PF, cosΦ, F, temp, V-THD, I-THD), device, optional DIO/AO.

| Klemsan KLEA Network Energy Analyzer (Modbus RTU RS-485)
| Protocol: Modbus RTU; FC03 read, FC06 write single, FC10 write multiple, FC14 read file record
| All registers 32-bit (2 Modbus words each); addresses increment by +2 per 32-bit register,
| +4 per 64-bit register. Big-endian word order (high word at lower address).
| Data types: f32 = IEEE 754 float; u32 = unsigned 32-bit int; s32 = signed 32-bit int.
| 64-bit double registers split into two u32 entries: (high 32-bit) at base, (low 32-bit) at base+2.
| Starting address for measured data: 0. Settings: 2000+. Clear: 1898+.
| To save settings to non-volatile memory: write 0x0000 to register 1998, then 0x0001 to 1999
| within 60 seconds of last setting change.
| Archive records via FC14 (Read File Record): hourly files 1-1920, daily 5001-5240, monthly 10001-10036.
| Each archive block has 68 parameters (32-bit each): timestamp, then L1/L2/L3 avg/min/max V/I/P/Q/S/cosΦ/PF,
| line voltages V12/V23/V31 avg/min/max, frequency avg/min/max, T1 energy import/export active+reactive.
